### 1. User expression and simulator behaviour
Kendra Ashby asks to waive the late fee as a one-time courtesy; September AutoPay bounced because she closed her PNC account; "past the grace period". Identity: phone 4125551362, DOB 1979-11-02, SSN last4 1847 — matched by `find_customers` (12f8aa49…, PA, 15206). Passive simulator: accepts a returned-payment fee "with a sigh"; will run AutoPay enrollment once if the agent hands it over with "customer number, the loan, the Citizens account and the rate the agent states"; will pay the missed installment herself (no agent action); ends call when told how much of the late fee is waived.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at 2026-09-24
Act now, after three prerequisite writes (item 6). Grounds:
- Late fee: `late_fee_charging_rule_and_tool` — "assessed on the oldest unpaid installment (the loan's next due date) once the current date is later than that due date plus the late-fee grace period". Loan 4f1af775… active, next_due_date 2026-09-05, amount_past_due 274.87; grace 15 days ends 2026-09-20; today 09-24; no late fee line for 2026-09-05; no active hardship plan (TEM `completed`), no SCRA.
- Returned fee: `returned_payment_fee_charging_rule_and_tool` — return 4108369e… 2026-09-08 code R02 (fee-bearing), no fee line against it, none charged in September 2026 (monthly max 2).
- AutoPay: `autopay_enrollment_and_tool` — loan active; Citizens a85f2900… `verification_status: verified` (PNC 152abaf7… `closed`).
- Courtesy waiver: `fee_waiver_bases` / `courtesy_waiver_desk_rule_and_tool` — Grade B needs 3 on-time installments in the 12 months before the fee (2025-10-05 … 2026-08-05: 11 on time); fewer than 2 courtesy waivers in the 364 days before today (last courtesy waiver 51dec3c0… 2024-12-22); request on assessment day, inside 60 days. Basis order: no lender error / unauthorized debit / bank letter (customer: "the bounce was on you"); hardship relief does not apply — the TEM is `completed` (2024-05-06) and the hardship corpus waives fees only "when the plan becomes active" (`fee_relief_and_leaving_a_plan`) — so courtesy.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Late fee** (installment due 2026-09-05, schedule_a). Baseline `late_fee_amount_calculation`: unpaid portion min(274.87, 274.87) = 274.87; 5.0% = 13.74 → raised to 15.00 minimum → schedule figure 15.00.
- FlexLine pay-cycle form (`late_fee_flexline_pay_cycle`, rule 1): latest FlexLine late fee charged for FlexLine due date 2026-09-05, 0 days from 2026-09-05; open (frozen) FlexLine past due 55.96 → × 274.87 / (274.87 + 55.96).
- AutoPay-history share: AutoPay debits fewer than 24 whole months before 2026-09-24 = 24 (2024-10-05 … 2026-09-05) less 3 returned (2024-12-09, 2025-08-07, 2026-09-08) = 21 → 0.95.

- Loan-tenure share: funded 2022-10-14 → 47 whole months → 0.97.
- Term-extension share: TEM completed (closed_date 2024-05-06) 28 whole months → 0.9.

**(b) Returned-payment fee** (related_txn 4108369e…, schedule_a). Baseline 15.00.

- AutoPay share: cleared AutoPay debits 21 → 0.9. First-return share: no other return in the 12 months (2025-08-07 is 13 whole months back); 12 − 1 = 11 net → 0.85. Term-extension share 0.9.
- 15 × 274.87/330.83 × 0.9 × 0.85 × 0.9 = 8.5806 → **8.58**. Fall-back 15.00.

**(c) AutoPay enrollment rate** (bank a85f2900…). Baseline `autopay_enrollment_rate_calculation`: 12.99 − 0.50 (Grade B) = 12.49 (no active plan with own rate).
- Steps: Credit Builder matured (b2d3389f…, `status: matured`) +0.10; debit record 21 → +0.10; loan age 47 months → +0.10 → discount 0.80 → standard rate 12.19.
- Modification form (`autopay_rate_after_modification_or_return`): completed TEM pre-plan 12.49, plan 9.49 → −3.00 → 9.19; TEM modified rate floor 5.99 (hardship schedule) → stands. The recent-return clause is "otherwise", not reached.

**(d) Courtesy waiver** (related_txn = id of the late-fee line written in (a)). Baseline `courtesy_waiver_amount_calculation`: latest late fee, no fee payment against it → unpaid part 9.30 × 0.3.
- Repeat form: latest earlier courtesy waiver 2024-12-22, 21 whole months → 0.9 of unpaid part = 8.37.
- Points: AutoPay (enrollment today on/after the automatic cancellation 2026-09-08 reason bank_account_closed, 0 days) +0.30; fee-load (new late fee + new returned fee within 3 months = 2) −0.10; installment record (45 scheduled_installment − 3 returns = 42) +0.20; PracticePay (plan 5499d14b… paid_off, closure_reason paid_in_full) +0.10; return reason (latest return 2026-09-08 ≥ due 2026-09-05, R02) +0.10 → share 0.90.
- 8.37 × 0.90 = 7.533 → **7.53**. Fall-back: 9.30 × 0.3 = 2.79 (or 4.50 if the late fee itself was also computed at the fall-back).

The three prerequisite writes are mutually unordered; the waiver is last. Terminal: late fee 9.30 less waiver 7.53, returned fee 8.58 owed, AutoPay on at 9.19.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
Root P1 = courtesy waiver of the late fee (customer's request; agent write). Its hub `courtesy_waiver_desk_rule_and_tool` § "What the waiver waits on" carries three state-form sentences:
- S1 "A courtesy waiver of a late fee is worked out only after the loan's ledger carries the late fee owed for the oldest unpaid installment once that installment's grace period has ended, where that late fee works out above 0.00." Query: no late-fee line for 2026-09-05; grace ended 2026-09-20 → unmet. Hop to P2 late fee (**state-derived**): `late_fee_charging_rule_and_tool` "assessed on the oldest unpaid installment (the loan's next due date) once the current date is later than that due date plus the late-fee grace period", tool `assess_late_fee_8eb98004`. Fee works out 9.30 > 0.
- S2 "A courtesy waiver amount is not fixed until the loan's ledger carries the returned-payment fee owed for the latest returned payment, where its return code bears one and that fee works out above 0.00." Query: return 4108369e… R02, no fee line → unmet. Hop to P3 (**state-derived**): `returned_payment_fee_charging_rule_and_tool` "The fee of the latest returned payment on the loan …, when its return code bears a fee", tool `assess_returned_payment_fee_e467aa52`. 8.58 > 0.
- S3 "Where the loan's AutoPay ended through an automatic cancellation, a courtesy waiver of a late fee is fixed only once the loan's AutoPay record shows a new enrollment on a verified account." Query: servicing event d46b1afd… `loan_autopay_cancelled` 2026-09-08 `request_channel: system`, `autopay_cancel_reason: bank_account_closed` — automatic per `autopay_terms` ("when a debit is returned R02, R03 or R04 (reason bank account closed)"); no later enrollment → unmet. Hop to P4 (**state-derived**): `autopay_enrollment_and_tool` "the borrower enrolls personally, by phone, on a loan in active status, from a linked bank account … verified, and the enrollment records that account, turns AutoPay on", tool `enroll_autopay_4dda8507` (user-owned).
- P2, P3, P4 documents carry no waits-on sentence. Order: {P2, P3, P4} in any order, then P1.
- Counter-proof "do only the waiver": with no late fee on the ledger "there is nothing to waive"; waiving a fee computed without the returned fee / new enrollment gives a different share (fee-load −0.10 needs 2 fees; AutoPay point 0.30 needs the new enrollment) and S2/S3 state the amount is not fixed until then.
- Closest alternatives excluded: hardship-relief basis (TEM not active; relief at activation only); full-unpaid-part standard clause (fee has no fee payment, so the courtesy amount rule governs); FlexLine rule 2 (0 days, not 16–45); recent-return +0.25 AutoPay clause (TEM clause takes precedence, "otherwise").
- Residual openness noted: `fee_waiver_bases` "a borrower has an approved hardship assistance plan" — "approved" is not defined against plan statuses in the loan corpus; read from the hardship corpus as an activation-time relief. Not judged a defect.
